{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in the two columns of interest
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
missing_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()

# Check the data types and basic stats
penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].describe(), (missing_flipper, missing_mass)"}
